verdicts.method: code reading (three.js:18186-18215, 18075-18083, 17954-17966, 17877, 13791-13814, 14116-14119; app.js:3714-3719, 3757-3761) + new A/B probe on both builds counting getProgram (customProgramCacheKey) calls per frame with the lights as built (A) and also on LAYER_LABEL (B, page-local)
verdicts.evidence: A: 313 getProgram a frame in L3 (all MeshStandardMaterial), 318 now (103 MeshStandard + 215 kit materials with the anim hook), in every A run; B: 0 a frame in all 7 B runs, both builds. Cause: renderFX's label pass (camera.layers LAYER_LABEL) sees none of the three layer-0 lights, so r128's shared render state's lights hash changes and state.version is bumped twice a frame, and every lit material drawn in the world pass re-derives its program (cache hit). Desktop bound: effects-off orbit (no label pass) 4.0 vs 4.8 ms L3, 5.1 vs 5.8/5.9 now (STAGE8_SPEC.md:5559-5560): at most ~0.7-0.8 ms a frame. docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-perfattr/
verdicts.notes: Inherited (L3 313/frame; label pass predates Stage 8). Container A-B timing noisy (loop median 4.5 ms over 13 pairs, range -4.1 to +14.4). Remedy: lights on both layers plus renderer.shadowMap.autoUpdate=false around the label pass (else the label pass re-renders and clears sun.shadow.map, which the self-test reads, app.js:13238); label objects are unlit sprites; pixels not tested.
